title: SaaS UI lab 2 (source of the round-2 SaaS UI templates)
summary: The 7 comps the round-2 SaaS UI templates were built and verified in: lower third, feature title, CTA end card, modal over an app, chart card, chat thread and dropdown menu.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 SaaS UI template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a product video, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing it.

comps: SU Modal (90 f, full app frame)

carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Each comp except SU Modal has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg". SU Modal is extracted whole (it is a full app frame).
Clip ids are unique per comp (slt_, sft_, sec_, smd_, scc_, sct_, sdd_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/saas_ui_lab2.py writes the comps; apply its PRESETS with preset.apply (they come from the SaaS UI, Motion Patterns and data-viz packs), then edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (notes only).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
